01 The gap

Your network dashboard ends where the business begins.

Impact, Awin, CJ and Rakuten all answer one question well: what did the network record? None of them answer the questions a client actually asks in a QBR.

  • Did affiliate bring customers worth keeping, or discount-chasers who never come back?
  • Which orders should have been tracked, and weren’t?
  • What does this channel do to blended CAC once you net out returns and reversals?
  • Is this partner worth what we pay them across our whole book, not just this program?

Every agency answers these. Most answer them in a spreadsheet, once a quarter, by hand — and can’t answer them at all between quarters.

Every brand in one view — with the problems surfaced for you.

A tracking break, found without anyone going looking for it

04 Recovery

Find the orders the network never recorded.

The console already holds each brand’s Shopify orders next to Impact’s actions. It compares order IDs directly — no CSV export, no manual VLOOKUP — and flags orders that had an affiliate click in the customer journey or a registered promo code, but no matching action.

Flagged orders are submitted back to Impact from the same screen, and every submission is logged with its response.

Honest: recovery volume depends on the brand’s tracking health. The mechanism is live; the period shown returned zero flagged, which is the answer you want.

06 The argument

Proof that partnership customers are worth keeping.

First-order source cohorts, tracked through to lifetime value. On this store, partnership customers carry €287 LTV against €209 for facebook — and 75% of them are new to the brand.

console.stratagem.agency/e-commerce — LTV by acquisition channel

This is the hardest claim in affiliate to defend, and the one that decides next year’s budget. It comes out of the console as a chart, not as a spreadsheet argument.

07 Client view

console.stratagem.agency/advertisers

Thirteen KPIs, benchmarked against sector.

  • LTV and CAC side by side — €127.57 against €10.23 on this account.
  • Reversals and lost revenue as first-class numbers, not a footnote after the fact.
  • Sector comparison on every KPI with one toggle: +210% actions, +132% revenue, +31% active partners.

The same view backs the client-facing roles, so a brand contact sees their own account and nothing else.

08 Strategy

Partner economics, split by what partners actually do.

Loyalty, commerce content and media arbitrage have completely different economics. Averaging them hides everything that matters. The console segments them and gives each its own conversion rate, CPA, CPC, RoAS, ROI and new-customer share — against best-in-class benchmarks.

console.stratagem.agency/gap-analysis

09 Leverage

Partner intelligence across the whole book, not one program.

The Brands column is the part a single-program dashboard can never show you.

console.stratagem.agency/performance-partners

A partner running on 10 of your 11 clients is a negotiation. A partner on 1 of 12 is an opportunity. Neither is visible from inside a single program.

10 Governance

Brand bidding and click integrity, monitored.

Risk scoring across affiliate revenue spikes, near-zero click latency, multi-order clicks, IP velocity and conversion-rate plausibility — with an investigation checklist attached to each signal.

Program governance is work agencies already bill for. This turns it into something that runs continuously instead of when someone remembers to check.

12 Under the hood

The part that took two years and is hard to copy.

Pipeline

Sync orchestration

Per-source scheduled tasks, Postgres pg_cron for daily aggregation, and a materialised view refreshed every ten minutes behind the portfolio view.

Hard-won

Impact API landmines

Report ranges over a year silently truncate to ~18 days. Exactly one field carries true reversed revenue. One innocuous report parameter corrupts media IDs. Each cost weeks to find.

Correctness

Money that adds up

Per-store currency, VAT-inclusive net sales, reversal-aware revenue, mixed-grain return dating. Unglamorous, and exactly where competing tools quietly produce wrong numbers.

Tenancy

Multi-agency from the start

Seven roles, per-page permissions, agency-scoped access and per-advertiser encrypted credentials — plus the demo mode blurring every client name in this deck.
